title: Alur KPI/OKR (Periode KPI -> Penilaian -> Review/Publish + OKR Objectives/Key-Results)
description: Alur manajemen kinerja CV. Dewi Aditya lintas Portal SDM & Manajemen. Sisi KPI (SDM): HR membuat PERIODE KPI (draft->open->closed->finalized) berisi peserta + bank soal 360, lalu PENILAIAN dilakukan (nilai Perform diinput HR/atasan; form Attitude 360 self/peer/supervisor/staff diisi via submissions; Absensi dihitung dari kehadiran), kemudian REVIEW: hitung hasil (KPI Final = Perform 60% + Attitude 20% + Absensi 20%, grading A-E), lihat hasil, dan PUBLISH (cek completion >=80%, auto-usul kenaikan gaji Grade A/B, award badge). Sisi OKR (Manajemen): buat Objective + Key Results dengan progress otomatis (on_track/at_risk/off_track) dan dashboard company OKR health.
happy_path_steps: Periode: HR buat periode KPI (draft) + peserta; transisi status draft->open (auto peer-assignment)
Penilaian: input nilai Perform per karyawan (single & bulk); form Attitude via submissions (skor 1-5); Absensi dari kehadiran
Review: hitung KPI Final (Perform 60% + Attitude 20% + Absensi 20%) + grading A-E
Publish: cek completion >=80% (warning bila kurang), publish -> periode finalized + auto usul kenaikan gaji Grade A/B + badge
OKR: buat Objective + Key Results, update progress KR, dashboard OKR health
rbac_note: Konfigurasi & hasil KPI dibatasi role HR/Manager/Supervisor (_require_hr: superadmin/admin/owner/hr/manager/supervisor). Form submissions/my-forms untuk karyawan yang terhubung ke data pegawai. OKR create/delete dibatasi superadmin/admin/manager/owner. Role non-HR (mis. admin_gudang) ditolak 403.
verification: backend API POC ALL PASS (tests/flow_sdm_kpi_okr_test.py): periode create+guard nama 400+transisi invalid 400+delete non-draft 400, RBAC non-HR 403, questions seed + invalid eval_type 400, perform single+bulk, submissions guard skor di luar 1-5 -> 400, calculate (KPI Final 60/20/20 grade A) + guard no-participant 400, results list, publish completion<80 warning + force finalize, OKR objective+KR+progress+dashboard + RBAC 403. DB pristine setelah cleanup.
notes: KPI Final = Perform*0.60 + Attitude*0.20 + Absensi*0.20. Attitude 360 = self 20% + peer 20% + supervisor->staff 35% + staff->supervisor 25%. Grade: A(91-100 naik 10%), B(80-90 perpanjang 7%), C(75-79 mediasi), D(50-69 cut off), E(0-49 cut off).
